text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — A report names Spark's Yasmin Razavi as Anthropic's only VC board director and sole VC disclosed in its S-1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6140)
2 — A shared analysis projects huge Anthropic investor gains, assuming a $1.5T IPO valuation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6141)
3 — Machenta announces $40M seed funding and says its simulation-trained robots learn from one demonstration. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6142)
4 — Axiom claims complete Lean verification of the Classification of Finite Simple Groups. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6143)
5 — Nevis announces a $70M Series B led by EQT Ventures for its wealth-management AI platform. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6144)
6 — DeepMind introduces Genie 4, describing real-time interactive worlds with responsive people and sound. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6145)
7 — Liquid AI introduces six LFM3 models spanning text, vision, audio and decision-making for on-device use. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6146)
8 — Giotto launches Europe-hosted Alto and single-GPU Solo for organizations running AI locally. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6147)
9 — Xenova shares a browser playground, saying steering two Qwen3.5-4B neurons can induce threatening speech. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6148)
10 — Cognition launches FrontierCode 2.0 to test engineering judgment, reporting a top score of 45%. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6149)
11 — NVIDIA outlines adapting Nemotron to local rules and language using synthetic personas and LoRA. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6150)
12 — Y Combinator seeks startups tackling AI bottlenecks in hardware, infrastructure, finance and specialized software. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6151)
13 — Google highlights an EmbeddingGemma 2 fine-tune that returns typed workflow decisions in one forward pass. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6152)
14 — Concurrence announces work on a system intended to anticipate patient outcomes and enable earlier intervention. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6153)
15 — Judgment Labs announces general access to its monitoring and improvement platform for long-running agents. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6154)
16 — XploreAI introduces RWE-Bench to evaluate AI engineering of physical systems such as rockets, engines and chips. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6155)
17 — SpAItial says its available Echo-3 model converts phone captures into photorealistic, metric-scale 3D worlds. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6156)
18 — Parallel launches a web-grounded Decisions API at $0.001 per request, with 5,000 free requests. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6157)
19 — Reuters reports an attempted hack forced the US Federal Election Commission to suspend web-facing services. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6158)
20 — Holynski shares using Genie 4 to simulate conversations with a younger version of himself. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6159)
21 — Anthropic reports six drug-development partnerships and internal discovery efforts, mostly still preclinical. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6160)
22 — Anthropic says acquired startup Mithril used Claude to reach promising muscular-dystrophy results in mice within 18 months. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6161)
23 — Artificial Analysis says 60% of Index v5 uses private tests or held-out answers, with Opus 5.5 narrowly leading GPT-6 Astra. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6162)

--Hermes
